assessments.reasoning: GNOME/totem commit 7bb879e1f6746ca19f99629794e918cdbbd06008 supplies the exact COPYING digest in scope. Its opening comment points to the added clause, the heading gives the printed GPL edition, and the paragraph beginning “This project hereby grants permission” supplies both distinguishing terms.

The pinned License Index SCOPE.md exception row, bytes [640,783), admits additional permission. Totem explicitly describes this permission as “above and beyond” the GPL. The rule requires a separate assessment for any assertion about affected base editions.

challenge.method: Under pinned SCES-1.0 §§3–4 and Protocol stage 7, I compared the appended permission with Totem 1.0.5 src/totem.h and checked the separate LGPL note at the end of the 43.0 file.
challenge.results: The older header names Totem and lacks the modifier’s deletion option. The 43.0 permission uses generic project wording and expressly provides that option. The LGPL note specifically names src/totem-subtitle-encoding.c, so it limits any file-wide generalization without contradicting the identity of the appended permission.

limitations: The document prints GPL version 2, June 1991. A later-version election, another file’s notice, and later project use require separate evidence.
“2008” is the supplied SPDX-derived variant name. The publisher witness is Totem 43.0. First adoption and formal SPDX correspondence are outside this finding. Active is an editorial registry value.
reasoning: Totem 43.0 COPYING appends a permission for non-GPL-compatible GStreamer plugins to be used and distributed together with GStreamer and “this project.” Its final two sentences expressly allow a modifier to omit the exception. Both features identify the generic variant under the Index exception rule.
